The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency (Naturvårdsverket) runs the Ladda bilen grant for charging points for residents, employees and guests.
Housing associations (bostadsrättsföreningar), joint property associations and other associations can apply for chargers the association owns.
The grant covers material and labour for new charging points, including the electrical work.
Applications are open all year. New rules apply from 1 February 2026: companies must apply before installation starts.
